# Lyrenza Mexico City Polanco

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Mexico City Polanco is in Mexico City, Mexico, in the North America region.
Facilities: Rooftop pool; spa; contemporary Mexican restaurant; club lounge. Pool or water-facility hours: 07:00-21:00.
Parking: Valet parking; MXN 420 nightly. Transportation: Private airport transfer available.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
